profiles.name: Muhyiddin Yassin
profiles.position: Member of the Dewan Rakyat; President of Bersatu
profiles.description: Muhyiddin Yassin represents Pagoh, Johor, in the Dewan Rakyat. Current role: Member of the Dewan Rakyat; President of Bersatu. Affiliated with Bersatu. Also recorded by Parliament as Mahiaddin Md Yasin.

profile_sources.label: Bersatu · October CSA signatory and opposition status

profiles.affiliation_note: Parliament records the formal name Mahiaddin Md Yasin. The established public name Muhyiddin Yassin and fixed plan identity refer to the same Pagoh MP. The October CSA explicitly does not move Bersatu into government.

profiles.name: Syed Ibrahim Syed Noh
profiles.position: Deputy Minister of Natural Resources and Environmental Sustainability
profiles.description: Syed Ibrahim Syed Noh represents Ledang, Johor, in the Dewan Rakyat. Current role: Deputy Minister of Natural Resources and Environmental Sustainability. Affiliated with PKR.

profiles.name: Tan Hong Pin
profiles.description: Tan Hong Pin represents Bakri, Johor, in the Dewan Rakyat. Affiliated with DAP.

milestones.title: Launch the DGIRT geospatial response pilot vehicle
milestones.description: Syed Ibrahim launched the dedicated vehicle developed by JUPEM with the Armed Forces to combine geospatial instruments, drones and field-response equipment.
milestones.progress_note: Achieved is limited to the reported pilot launch. It does not certify fleet-wide deployment, response-time improvements or the deputy minister’s sole responsibility.

milestones.title: Support Supply Bill 2027 under the confidence-and-supply agreement
milestones.description: Signed the agreement committing support for the 2027 Supply Bill.
milestones.progress_note: The agreement is documented. A subsequent budget vote or final passage was not established in this pass; signing is not counted as delivery of the bill or joining another party.

methodology: Commitments, documented activities and limited delivery reports are distinct. Evidence-only records have no invented earlier promise. Achieved covers the described handover, programme session or launch only. Shared agency responsibility, historical dates, count units, source limitations and missing follow-up evidence are explicit. No claim of exhaustive research is made.
